name: IBoundedGSet
doc: A bounded grow-only set view supporting capacity constraints and heat emissions.

members.name: Capacity
members.doc: The maximum capacity of the set.

members.name: IsSaturated
members.doc: Whether the capacity has been reached.

laws.doc: The no-forget policy rejects over-capacity additions through backpressure rather than evicting materialized elements.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/BoundedGSet.Tests.fs:forget policies keep the configured side and report heat
laws.doc: Forgetting policies report the forgotten finite-view loss as heat.

laws.proof: tests/Tests.FSharp/Algebra/BoundedGSet.Tests.fs:bounded union is idempotent and associative for one projection policy
laws.doc: Bounded union is idempotent and associative when both operands use the same projection policy.
